name: Ai Shi Ji
source:
"Huh?! Diabetes? Me?!" Fresh out of college and new to the workforce, Mi Lirong is shocked when her doctor warns her of diabetes and serious health risks. While night jogging to get back in shape, she bumps into He Siqiu, a mysterious and stunning fitness coach... who suddenly invites her to a hotel?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4385620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“啊？！糖尿病？我？！”米丽蓉刚从大学毕业，刚刚参加工作，当她的医生警告她患有糖尿病和严重的健康风险时，她感到震惊。晚上慢跑健身时，她偶遇神秘绝色的健身教练何思秋……他突然邀请她去酒店？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4385620/]Steam[/url]]
